text: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. One of its main goals is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in what people write. NLP is also used for translation, so tools can quickly turn a text from one language into another. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover whether customers feel positive, negative, or neutral about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, our daily interactions with technology are becoming easier and more helpful.
